[{"insert":"Dumbbell Pullover + DB Bent Over Meadows Row

Two movements targeting the lat from different positions, back-to-back. The dumbbell pullover loads the lat at full shoulder flexion, in the long head stretch position. The Meadows row that follows drives the elbow back through a horizontal path with a slight rotational component. Together, they build lat thickness and length in the same session. Push close to failure on each set.
"}]
